sources.name: Phosphor Icons
sources.note: The Glass field and buttons use the original SVGs from assets/bold/arrow-up-bold.svg, arrow-down-bold.svg, magnifying-glass-bold.svg, arrow-elbow-down-left-bold.svg, circle-notch-bold.svg and check-bold.svg. The full upstream license is in arrow-up-bold.mjs, which also holds the arrow down; its path was checked against the same icon of @iconify-json/ph 1.2.2 in illustrations/.
